summary: SEC18 source UX: clear request-bound ckSOL progress + persistent Minted confirmation. Iris implementation; Ellis integration/mock desktop-mobile QA; independent mapping review. Paymentsettled != mintconfirmed; preserve owner/request guards, polling/backoff/hiddenpause and no duplicatefinancialretry. Sourcebranch separate from frozen00cf SEC17 release, which remains approved but coordination-message-held. No newmint/wallet/deployment action.
plainSummary: We are improving ckSOL’s progress display so users can see whether a request is being processed, needs attention, or has completed. Success will remain prominent until they choose another deposit. This work is separate from the approved repayment release, whose build coordination is still blocked.

glossary.definition: The pool that absorbs certain liquidations and receives protocol interest.
The compiled canister program installed on the Internet Computer. A merged source change may differ from the installed program.
A points period paused for operator review before its rewards are finalized.
An older ledger block range served from a ledger archive canister.
The configured destination that must be read back and confirmed before a recovery payment is allowed.
A limited pool of processing funds. The ckSOL reserve is currently off and cannot spend.
Backend cycles that must remain available for operating needs and already-recorded liabilities before a paid request may proceed.
A collateral withdrawal from a vault with no outstanding stablecoin debt; health checks still apply if debt is present.
